doc.title: Billie Pierce, De De Pierce, Israel Gorman, Joseph "Kid Twat" Butler Interview, 1963-11-20

title: De De Pierce explains his nickname
summary: De De Pierce gives his name and says a cousin gave him the nickname.

story.theme_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band monikers
story.community_name: How I got my name: nicknames and band names

blocks.x: All right, the D, what's your name? Joseph.
Your full name? Joseph, like my peers. But everyone calls you the D, huh? Yeah, yeah.
What kind of nickname is that?
Well, I know, it's a little niece of mine, years ago, come up together. I mean, a cousin of mine come up together. And it's stuck, you know? Oh, yeah. She gave it to you? She gave it to me, yeah.
